decisions.reason: The same message already records the candidate-specific shift toward an investment story and investor attractiveness; the separate simplification and auditability decision requires no additional narrative-state change.
The dashboard-specific purpose and required metrics are already captured from this message, while simplifying the broader model does not alter those dashboard requirements.
Making the model easier to understand and audit does not necessarily change the existing requirements to annotate assumptions or use specified source materials.
Structural simplicity and auditability do not change the candidate's data-review, error-checking, or formula-integrity standards.
The request to simplify the overall model does not specify any change to the confirmed debt-equity split, debt cost, mezzanine treatment, or financing structure.
The message reiterates viability and bankability goals but does not change the existing availability-payment sizing targets or justification requirements.
The simplification and auditability decision does not alter any capex estimate, assumption basis, or shared-cost treatment.
The source decision does not change the selected operating-cost range, its source basis, or the excluded Appendix basis.
Simplifying the model does not change the authoritative Business Case site list.
